name: Small bus (SORCE class)
description: A small, light spacecraft body. Cheap and quick to build, but it can only carry and power a little, and its radio is slow.

source.title: NASA Earth Science Reference Handbook (2006)
source.detail: Key SORCE Facts and instrument facts, PDF p. 232-235. Bus mass = 315 kg spacecraft minus 66.6 kg of instruments flown.

name: Medium bus (EO-1 class)
description: A mid-sized spacecraft body with a fast X-band radio. Room for one or two modest instruments.

source.title: NASA Earth Science Reference Handbook (2006)
source.detail: Key EO-1 Facts and instrument facts, PDF p. 142-144. Bus mass = 529 kg spacecraft minus 100.5 kg of instruments (ALI and LAC).

name: Large bus (Landsat 7 class)
description: A big, strong spacecraft body that can carry and power a heavy instrument and send data home very fast. Costly and slow to build.

source.title: NASA Earth Science Reference Handbook (2006)
source.detail: Key Landsat 7 Facts and Key ETM+ Facts, PDF p. 188-190. Bus mass = 1982 kg spacecraft minus the 425 kg ETM+. Downlink is one of its three 150 Mbps links.

name: Space Shuttle Orbiter

name: Shuttle payload bay

source.title: NASA Spacecraft Dimensions and Flight Summary Information

source.title: JPL Mars Exploration Rover Launch Press Kit
source.detail: Quick Facts: stage and launch propellant masses. Demonstrated carried mass = 174 + 365 + 198 + 90 kg.

name: Pathfinder cruise stage
description: Takes an airbag-equipped landing system to Mars.

source.title: NASA PDS Mars Pathfinder Lander Description
source.detail: Spacecraft Summary: 894 kg launch minus 584 kg entry mass minus 94 kg propellant (JPL Mars Pathfinder Landing Press Kit, Spacecraft) = 216 kg. Carried mass uses the entry mass.

name: Curiosity cruise stage
description: A heavy cruise stage for rover and entry hardware.

source.title: JPL Mars Science Laboratory Landing Press Kit
source.detail: Quick Facts: 539 kg fueled stage; carried 899 kg rover + 2401 kg entry system. MSL full load of 475 kg (NASA Mars 2020 final EIS §2.6.2.2) minus 387 kg usable descent load (MSL press kit, Descent Stage) gives an approximate cruise allocation of 88 kg. Game derives dry mass as 539 - 88 kg.

name: InSight aeroshell

source.title: JPL InSight Launch Press Kit
source.detail: Quick Facts: mass, lander mass and cruise assembly height and diameter as game fit bounds.

name: Spirit aeroshell
description: A protective enclosure for the journey through Mars' atmosphere.

source.title: JPL Mars Exploration Rover Launch Press Kit
source.detail: Quick Facts: 198 kg backshell and parachute + 90 kg shield; 174 kg rover + 365 kg lander. Cruise assembly height and diameter are game fit bounds.

name: Pathfinder entry system
description: A protective enclosure for the journey through Mars' atmosphere.

source.title: NASA PDS Mars Pathfinder Lander Description
source.detail: Entry system mass 584 - 370 kg. JPL Landing Press Kit, Spacecraft: 1.5 m cruise vehicle height and 2.65 m diameter are game fit bounds.

name: Mars 2020 entry system
description: A protective enclosure for the journey through Mars' atmosphere.

source.title: NASA Planetary Mission Entry Vehicles Quick Reference Guide
source.detail: Mars 2020, p. 34: 3317.3 kg entry mass minus 1022.8 kg payload, minus 390 kg design descent propellant (NASA Mars 2020 final EIS §2.1.2). Game uses the rounded JPL 1025 kg rover mass as the demonstrated fit limit. The 4.5 m outer diameter and Curiosity's 3 m cruise height are game fit bounds. Uses the same 390 kg design load as the descent tank capacity.
